composition: Belle Époque Casino cupolas on the palm-lined Riviera lungomare · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the lungomare, the tourist looks along the palm-lined promenade toward the white Belle Epoque Casino, its silvered cupolas rising center-frame above the sea wall. Tall palms stand in the right foreground with pastel palazzi behind them, while the green hillside town climbs to the left and the blue sea fills the far left. The 12:11 sun is bright and high under a clear blue sky, and strollers dot the shady walkway.
